boundaries: Historical v42/v43 pins intentionally refer to the exact reviewed deployment ancestry. Public sanitized manifest prefixes differ; these pins must not be silently rewritten to the public prefix.

Publication of source does not authorize any actual installation or prove that the public checkout is an executable deployment tuple. Exact current inputs, complete history, native validators, consumer/build/PM custody and one consumed transaction remain separate.
Source-update v44 is recognized only as required committed ancestry for v5. This package does not implement the separate Source90 PM/cache compiler or grant its admission.

The tests use isolated synthetic homes and explicit native/service admission fixtures. Production native renderer loading, current retained state, authenticated serving/UI, model/delivery behavior and release acceptance require separate actual checks.
No old source/project schemas, clocks, consumed-attempt no-retry rules, source/renderer/history/CAS/rollback/lock gates are removed.
Only the Dashboard typed pair and marker may publish through v5; the updater helper remains a project-source pin.

provenance.implementation: Existing project updater and owner-authorized prepared source derivatives, plus the narrow receipt-name privacy correction. No new third-party implementation or binary assets are vendored.
provenance.license: Existing THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md applies to its identified portions. This change does not assign a new license to the integration repository. Source constants reference separately licensed native/model assets without copying their bodies.
provenance.tests: Existing prepared synthetic source-transaction fixtures, portable Dashboard fixtures, adversarial CAS/cancellation controls and new receipt/renderer input controls. No actual request, journal, account record, credential or database is included.

scope: Existing source-update v42 bundle and v43 exact-response implementation
Project-update v5 Dashboard typed settings on committed Source90 plus exactly one renderer-v3 rebind
Opaque per-account Telegram receipt retention without embedding an account identifier
